title: UPSC CDS 2 2026 Notification OUT - 451 Officer Vacancies in IMA, INA, AFA & OTA, Apply by June 9
author: Ash K.
summary: UPSC released CDS 2 2026 notification (Notice No. 11/2026-CDS-II) on May 20 for 451 officer vacancies across IMA (100), INA (26), AFA (32), OTA Men (275), OTA Women (18). Apply online at upsconline.nic.in by June 9, 2026 at 6:00 PM. Written exam: September 13, 2026. Fee: ₹200 for General/OBC male; NIL for women and SC/ST.
body: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the CDS 2 Notification 2026 (Notice No. 11/2026-CDS-II) on May 20, 2026, for 451 officer vacancies across the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), Air Force Academy (AFA), and Officers' Training Academy (OTA). The online application is active at upsconline.nic.in - last date is June 9, 2026 at 6:00 PM. The written exam is scheduled for September 13, 2026.

Exam pattern: IMA, INA, and AFA candidates appear in three papers - English (100 marks, 2 hours), General Knowledge (100 marks, 2 hours), and Elementary Mathematics (100 marks, 2 hours). OTA candidates appear in only two papers - English and General Knowledge (Mathematics is not required). Negative marking applies: one-third of marks deducted per wrong answer. The written exam is held in offline mode at 41 centres across India.

Selection process: Written Examination → SSB Interview (Intelligence & Personality Test over 5 days) → Medical Examination → Merit List → Training at respective academy. The SSB interview is the most critical stage - only written exam qualifiers are called for SSB. Training duration at IMA, INA, and AFA is typically 12–18 months before commissioning as a lieutenant.

Face authentication: UPSC has made face authentication mandatory at the exam venue for CDS 2 2026. Candidates must ensure their application photo closely matches their actual appearance. No entry is allowed without the admit card, which will be released 2–3 weeks before the exam. See our NDA exam guide for the other key defence officer entry route, or UPSC CSE guide for civil services.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for UPSC CDS 2 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for UPSC CDS 2 2026 is June 9, 2026 at 6:00 PM. Applications must be submitted online at upsconline.nic.in. No applications are accepted after the deadline.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in UPSC CDS 2 2026?
faqs.answer: UPSC CDS 2 2026 has 451 vacancies - 100 for IMA, 26 for INA, 32 for AFA, 275 for OTA (Men), and 18 for OTA (Women). These are tentative and may be revised by Services HQ.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for UPSC CDS 2 2026?
faqs.answer: For IMA and OTA: Degree from a recognised university. For INA: Engineering Degree or B.Sc with Physics. For AFA: Degree with Physics and Maths at 10+2 level, or B.E./B.Tech. Age limit varies by academy - generally 19 to 24/25 years. Male candidates for IMA/INA/AFA/OTA (Men) must be unmarried.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for UPSC CDS 2 2026?
faqs.answer: General, OBC, and EWS male candidates pay ₹200. Female candidates and SC/ST candidates are fully exempted from the fee. Payment can be made via Net Banking, Visa/Master/RuPay card, or UPI.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for UPSC CDS 2 2026?
faqs.answer: IMA, INA, and AFA candidates appear in three papers: English (100 marks), General Knowledge (100 marks), and Elementary Mathematics (100 marks), each 2 hours long. OTA candidates appear in only two papers - English and General Knowledge. One-third negative marking applies.

faqs.question: What is the salary after selection in CDS 2 2026?
faqs.answer: During training, candidates receive a stipend of ₹56,100 per month. After commissioning as a Lieutenant, the pay is Level 10 under 7th Pay Commission - ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500 per month, plus military allowances, accommodation, and other service benefits.

callout.heading: Only 14 Days Left - Apply by June 9
callout.content: UPSC CDS 2 2026 application closes June 9 at 6:00 PM sharp. UPSC servers get heavily loaded near the deadline. Apply at upsconline.nic.in today. Keep your graduation certificate, photo ID, and passport-size photo ready before starting the form.
